role: Interface for processing a downloaded player skin image before it becomes a texture (parseUserSkin); used by SkinManager's ThreadDownloadImageData.
scope_reason: Player skins come from the Mojang session servers over the network; the C engine draws the fixed steve skin from the recorded assets (csrc/engine/raster_hand.c reads mobs/steve.rgba), so skin download processing is never reached.

members.name: func_152634_a
members.note: the skin-available callback; empty in ImageBufferDownload

notes: The only implementors are ImageBufferDownload and an anonymous class in SkinManager; both are download-time image processing.
